name: Freesurfer Group Analysis
summary: Aggregates FreeSurfer statistics across subjects, computing group mean and standard deviation of aseg volumes and of aparc thickness, gray matter volume and surface area, and shows them as bar plots.
description: Reads stats/aseg.stats and lh/rh.aparc.stats from each FreeSurfer input and writes product.json with bar plots of the across-subject mean and standard deviation per structure (voxel count, volume, normalised intensity, cortical thickness, gray matter volume and surface area). Use it for a quick visual group summary of FreeSurfer outputs on brainlife; it produces no output datasets. Needs several FreeSurfer outputs.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer subject directories (one per subject) whose stats/aseg.stats and stats/lh|rh.aparc.stats files are aggregated.
